body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Hand Fight with Leg Pickup Option
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand and hand fight for wrist, elbow, and head connections.
Get an inside, outside, or under-elbow connection. Then pick up your partner's leg at the knee or ankle.

items: Whoever controls and picks up a leg first wins. The same rule applies to both players.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is belly up in open guard. The top player is in front of him, hands already on him.

Top player: keep his feet off by clearing them and closing distance, stepping inside the knees or around the outside. Bottom player: use hooks, feet on the body, and posts to make the top player hit his butt or hands, then sit up with your back off the mat.

items: The top player wins by shin-to-body contact inside or outside the knees.
The bottom player wins by making the top player hit his butt and sitting up with your back off the mat.

body.text: Pinning, Continuous Hip and Shoulder Connection from All Fours
SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his hands and knees. The top player is behind him, hands locked around his waist.

Top player: use knee-to-knee and foot-to-foot blocking to pull his hips to the mat, switching between the hip grip and wrist grips to keep him belly down. Bottom player: get to a quad pod, both hands and both feet on the mat at the same time.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the bottom player belly down.
The bottom player wins by getting to a quad pod.
